name: A page's progress bars (a progress element and an ARIA progressbar) moving while the focus stays on the button that started them, with JAWS's progress bar announcements at their default (ProgressBarUpdateInterval=5000): Tab to the button, Enter starts 10, 20 and 30 within 1.5 s, 40 at 8 s and 100 at 14 s, the button renamed Done; then the virtual cursor down over both bars
